source_document: Sungrow String Inverter User Manual (SG110CX/SG125HV/SG33CX), Section 10.2 (Troubleshooting & Fault Codes)

FAULT_2.title: Grid Undervoltage
FAULT_2.description: Grid voltage is below the lower operating limit configured on the inverter.
FAULT_2.oem_definition: Grid Undervoltage (Fault 2). Utility grid AC voltage is consistently lower than lower trip limit.
potential_causes: Utility grid brownout or heavy local industrial load switching
Tripped AC circuit breaker or blown line fuse
AC disconnect switch open
FAULT_2.recommended_action: Check AC breaker and verify utility grid supply voltage. Inverter will auto-reconnect once grid recovers.

FAULT_3.title: Grid Transient Overvoltage
FAULT_3.description: Transient grid AC voltage spike exceeded statutory protection limit.
FAULT_3.oem_definition: Grid Transient Overvoltage (Fault 3). Instantaneous AC line surge detected.
potential_causes: Grid lightning surge or capacitor bank switching
Substation fault on distribution feeder
FAULT_3.recommended_action: Inverter will wait out disconnection timer and automatically attempt reconnect.

FAULT_4.title: Grid Transient Undervoltage
FAULT_4.description: Transient AC voltage drop below safe operational threshold.
FAULT_4.oem_definition: Grid Transient Undervoltage (Fault 4). Short-duration voltage dip detected.
potential_causes: Motor starting or sudden load increase on shared distribution transformer
Utility fault ride-through event
FAULT_4.recommended_action: Monitor grid stability; inverter will self-recover when voltage normalizes.

FAULT_8.title: Grid Underfrequency
FAULT_8.description: Grid AC frequency dropped below minimum operating limit.
FAULT_8.oem_definition: Grid Underfrequency (Fault 8). Frequency lower than minimum trip limit.
potential_causes: Severe generation-demand deficit on utility grid
Generator instability in microgrid/DG mode

FAULT_10.title: Grid Overfrequency
FAULT_10.description: Grid frequency exceeded maximum permissible frequency threshold.
FAULT_10.oem_definition: Grid Overfrequency (Fault 10). Frequency higher than grid protection limit.
potential_causes: Grid frequency fluctuation during sudden utility load loss
Microgrid frequency surge
FAULT_10.recommended_action: Inverter will auto-reconnect once grid frequency returns to nominal range.

FAULT_11.title: Grid Blackout / AC Power Loss
FAULT_11.description: Utility grid power completely lost at inverter AC terminals.
FAULT_11.oem_definition: Grid Power Outage (Fault 11). Zero voltage and zero current detected on all phases.
potential_causes: Utility power outage or planned load shedding
Upstream LT breaker or HT transformer isolator tripped
FAULT_11.recommended_action: Check AC main breaker and confirm site grid availability.

FAULT_12.title: Anti-Islanding Protection Trip
FAULT_12.description: Inverter anti-islanding circuit detected island operation condition.
FAULT_12.oem_definition: Islanding Fault (Fault 12). Active or passive anti-islanding threshold crossed.
potential_causes: Grid disconnect while solar output equals local plant load
High grid impedance during network reconfiguration
FAULT_12.recommended_action: Ensure utility grid is solidly connected and breaker is closed.

FAULT_14.title: Grid Phase Sequence Fault
FAULT_14.description: Three-phase AC output sequence is incorrect (e.g. reversed phases).
FAULT_14.oem_definition: Phase Sequence Error (Fault 14). Line phase angle or rotation reversed.
potential_causes: Reversed AC phase conductors during installation or cabling work
Utility line phase swap
FAULT_14.recommended_action: De-energize AC breaker, check phase sequence with rotation meter, and swap L1/L2 phases if reversed.

FAULT_15.title: Grid Overvoltage
FAULT_15.description: Grid AC voltage exceeded the upper operating threshold configured on the inverter.
FAULT_15.oem_definition: Grid Overvoltage (Fault 15). Utility grid AC voltage is consistently higher than upper trip limit.
potential_causes: Grid supply voltage elevated by utility substation tap setting
AC line resistance too high, causing voltage rise under full solar export
FAULT_15.recommended_action: Measure grid voltage. If grid voltage is normal, inspect AC wiring connections.

FAULT_16.title: Inverter AC Output Overcurrent
FAULT_16.description: AC current delivered by inverter exceeded instantaneous hardware limit.
FAULT_16.oem_definition: Output Overcurrent (Fault 16). Inverter AC current sensor triggered overcurrent protection.
potential_causes: Short circuit on AC cables or busbar
Sudden grid voltage sag causing inverter current surge
Internal inverter IGBT power bridge fault
FAULT_16.recommended_action: Isolate AC and DC switches. Inspect AC cabling for short circuits before restarting.

FAULT_19.title: Residual Current (RCD) Fault
FAULT_19.description: Leakage current to earth exceeded allowable residual current threshold.
FAULT_19.oem_definition: Excessive Leakage Current (Fault 19). Differential residual current sensor tripped.
potential_causes: Moisture or standing water in module junctions or conduit
Chafed cable conductor touching grounded frame
FAULT_19.recommended_action: Inspect DC cabling and module junctions for water ingress or insulation breakdown.

FAULT_36.title: Inverter Heatsink Overtemperature
FAULT_36.description: Inverter power module heatsink temperature exceeded thermal safety cutoff limits.
FAULT_36.oem_definition: Excessive Heatsink Temperature (Fault 36). Power IGBT heatsink thermal probe tripped.
potential_causes: Cooling fan seized or blocked
Dust accumulation on heatsink fins
Inadequate ventilation clearance
FAULT_36.recommended_action: Clean heatsink fins, test cooling fans, and ensure unrestricted air passage.

FAULT_37.title: Inverter Cabinet Overtemperature
FAULT_37.description: Inverter internal heatsink or ambient temperature exceeded thermal safety cutoff limits.
FAULT_37.oem_definition: Excessive Ambient/Internal Temperature (Fault 37). Temperature sensor inside inverter chassis tripped over-temperature threshold.
potential_causes: Inverter cooling fan blocked or seized
Air intake/outlet vents obstructed by vegetation or debris
Direct unshaded sunlight heating enclosure
FAULT_37.recommended_action: Clear air vents, check fan operation, and verify thermal environment.

FAULT_39.title: Isolation Fault (ISO-F)
FAULT_39.description: Ground isolation resistance of the PV array is below the safe operational threshold.
FAULT_39.oem_definition: Low Insulation Resistance (Fault 39). Inverter impedance measurement detected earth insulation resistance lower than safety standard.
potential_causes: PV array DC cable insulation mechanical damage
Water ingress in DC string combiner or module connectors
DC positive or negative conductor pinched against ground structure
FAULT_39.recommended_action: Check PV string insulation resistance to earth with megohmmeter. Locate and eliminate ground fault on DC side.

FAULT_40.title: DC Bus Overvoltage
FAULT_40.description: Inverter internal DC bus capacitor voltage exceeded hardware protection limit.
FAULT_40.oem_definition: DC Bus Overvoltage (Fault 40). Internal DC bus voltage sensor exceeded safety threshold.
potential_causes: PV array Voc in cold weather exceeds inverter rating
Grid disconnection under full load causing DC bus voltage spike
FAULT_40.recommended_action: Check string open circuit voltage against maximum permissible DC input voltage.

FAULT_42.title: PV Input Overcurrent
FAULT_42.description: DC input current into MPPT tracker exceeded allowable inverter maximum rating.
FAULT_42.oem_definition: PV Input Overcurrent (Fault 42). DC input current sensor triggered overcurrent threshold.
potential_causes: Incorrect parallel string connection exceeding MPPT rated Isc
Bifacial irradiance boost beyond input threshold
FAULT_42.recommended_action: Verify module string paralleling design and check MPPT maximum short-circuit current.

FAULT_43.title: String Reverse Polarity
FAULT_43.description: One or more DC strings are connected with reversed positive and negative polarity.
FAULT_43.oem_definition: String Reverse Polarity (Fault 43). Inverter detected negative DC voltage on string input.
potential_causes: Improper wiring termination during module installation or cable crimping
Crossed MC4 connector labeling
FAULT_43.recommended_action: De-energize inverter DC disconnect immediately. Use DC voltmeter to identify and correct reversed string.

FAULT_75.title: Communication Fault with Meter / Logger
FAULT_75.description: Inverter lost RS485 communication with smart meter or monitoring logger.
FAULT_75.oem_definition: Communication Error (Fault 75). Inverter modbus master port timed out waiting for meter/logger response.
potential_causes: RS485 cable loose or severed
Incorrect meter baud rate or modbus address
Meter auxiliary power offline
FAULT_75.recommended_action: Check meter RS485 communication wiring and verify communication parameters.

FAULT_532.title: String Underperformance / Zero Current
FAULT_532.description: One of the DC strings has zero current while other parallel strings are generating normally.
FAULT_532.oem_definition: String Abnormal Warning (Fault 532). Current deviation detected across monitored string inputs.
potential_causes: Blown DC string fuse
Disconnected MC4 plug or open-circuit bypass diode
Severely soiled or shaded module string
FAULT_532.recommended_action: Inspect string current in iSolarCloud, check string fuses, and measure open-circuit voltage at disconnect.
